'''{{PAGENAME}}''' and '''Damascius''' are students seen messing with a [[TARD-E Unit]] using [[Stargram]]s. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tae:''' Watch this. Get one of the Stargrams, stick it on the head of an Academy robot...

:'''Tae:''' And… voila! Now the robot copies everything I do.

:'''Damascius:''' What if I put it on a TARD-E Unit's head?

:'''Tae:''' Wait! Don't—

:'''TARD-E Unit:''' ♪ Is my thesis late? Then sleep must wait! ♪
{{Dialogue End}}
